title: When loneliness closes the room in under pressure
issueStatement: The heart feels unaccompanied even when people are nearby. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru joins belonging to remembrance, Sangat, and the nearness of the One. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Neediness is not rejected here. It is brought honestly into the Guru's care. Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone.
actionPrompt: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
